response.sql: WITH station_usage AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * SUM(telescope_count) / SUM(SUM(telescope_count)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM station_usage GROUP BY lunarstage

assumptions.assumption: The count and share refer to matched telescopes.

alternatives.interpretation: Count matched observatory stations and calculate their share instead.
